en.text: Of Moab. The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Woe to Nebo! For it is laid waste. Kiriathaim is disappointed. It is taken. Misgab is put to shame and broken down.

zhSimplified.text: 论摩押。万军之耶和华—以色列的 神如此说： 尼波有祸了！因变为荒场。 基列亭蒙羞被攻取； 米斯迦蒙羞被毁坏；

zhTraditional.text: 論摩押。萬軍之耶和華－以色列的上帝如此說： 尼波有禍了！因變為荒場。 基列亭蒙羞被攻取； 米斯迦蒙羞被毀壞；

en.text: The praise of Moab is no more. In Heshbon they have devised evil against her: ‘Come! Let’s cut her off from being a nation.’ You also, Madmen, will be brought to silence. The sword will pursue you.

zhSimplified.text: 摩押不再被称赞。 有人在希实本设计谋害她，说： 来吧！我们将她剪除，不再成国。 玛得缅哪，你也必默默无声； 刀剑必追赶你。

zhTraditional.text: 摩押不再被稱讚。 有人在希實本設計謀害她，說： 來吧！我們將她剪除，不再成國。 瑪得緬哪，你也必默默無聲； 刀劍必追趕你。

en.text: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!

zhSimplified.text: 从何罗念有喊荒凉大毁灭的哀声：

zhTraditional.text: 從何羅念有喊荒涼大毀滅的哀聲：

en.text: Moab is destroyed. Her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

zhSimplified.text: 摩押毁灭了！ 她的孩童发哀声，使人听见。

zhTraditional.text: 摩押毀滅了！ 她的孩童發哀聲，使人聽見。

en.text: For they will go up by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping. For at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.

zhSimplified.text: 人上鲁希坡随走随哭， 因为在何罗念的下坡听见毁灭的哀声。

zhTraditional.text: 人上魯希坡隨走隨哭， 因為在何羅念的下坡聽見毀滅的哀聲。

en.text: Flee! Save your lives! Be like the juniper bush in the wilderness.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要奔逃，自救性命， 独自居住，好像旷野的杜松。

zhTraditional.text: 你們要奔逃，自救性命， 獨自居住，好像曠野的杜松。

en.text: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also will be taken. Chemosh will go out into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

zhSimplified.text: 你因倚靠自己所做的和自己的财宝必被攻取。 基抹和属他的祭司、首领也要一同被掳去。

zhTraditional.text: 你因倚靠自己所做的和自己的財寶必被攻取。 基抹和屬他的祭司、首領也要一同被擄去。

en.text: The destroyer will come on every city, and no city will escape; the valley also will perish, and the plain will be destroyed, as the LORD has spoken.

zhSimplified.text: 行毁灭的必来到各城， 并无一城得免。 山谷必致败落， 平原必被毁坏； 正如耶和华所说的。

zhTraditional.text: 行毀滅的必來到各城， 並無一城得免。 山谷必致敗落， 平原必被毀壞； 正如耶和華所說的。

en.text: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get herself away: and her cities will become a desolation, without anyone to dwell in them.

zhSimplified.text: 要将翅膀给摩押， 使她可以飞去。 她的城邑必致荒凉， 无人居住。

zhTraditional.text: 要將翅膀給摩押， 使她可以飛去。 她的城邑必致荒涼， 無人居住。

en.text: “Cursed is he who does the work of the LORD negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.

zhSimplified.text: 懒惰为耶和华行事的，必受咒诅；禁止刀剑不经血的，必受咒诅。）

zhTraditional.text: 懶惰為耶和華行事的，必受咒詛；禁止刀劍不經血的，必受咒詛。）

en.text: “Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his dregs, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity; therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.

zhSimplified.text: 摩押自幼年以来常享安逸， 如酒在渣滓上澄清， 没有从这器皿倒在那器皿里， 也未曾被掳去。 因此，它的原味尚存， 香气未变。

zhTraditional.text: 摩押自幼年以來常享安逸， 如酒在渣滓上澄清， 沒有從這器皿倒在那器皿裏， 也未曾被擄去。 因此，它的原味尚存， 香氣未變。

en.text: Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will send to him those who pour off, and they will pour him off; and they will empty his vessels, and break their containers in pieces.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华说：「日子将到，我必打发倒酒的往她那里去，将她倒出来，倒空她的器皿，打碎她的坛子。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華說：「日子將到，我必打發倒酒的往她那裏去，將她倒出來，倒空她的器皿，打碎她的罈子。

en.text: Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.

zhSimplified.text: 摩押必因基抹羞愧，像以色列家从前倚靠伯特利的神羞愧一样。

zhTraditional.text: 摩押必因基抹羞愧，像以色列家從前倚靠伯特利的神羞愧一樣。

en.text: “How do you say, ‘We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war’?

zhSimplified.text: 你们怎么说： 我们是勇士，是有勇力打仗的呢？

zhTraditional.text: 你們怎麼說： 我們是勇士，是有勇力打仗的呢？

en.text: Moab is laid waste, and they have gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men have gone down to the slaughter,” says the King, whose name is the LORD of Armies.

zhSimplified.text: 摩押变为荒场， 敌人上去进了她的城邑。 她所特选的少年人下去遭了杀戮； 这是君王—名为万军之耶和华说的。

zhTraditional.text: 摩押變為荒場， 敵人上去進了她的城邑。 她所特選的少年人下去遭了殺戮； 這是君王－名為萬軍之耶和華說的。

en.text: “The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.

zhSimplified.text: 摩押的灾殃临近； 她的苦难速速来到。

zhTraditional.text: 摩押的災殃臨近； 她的苦難速速來到。

en.text: All you who are around him, bemoan him; and all you who know his name, say, ‘How the strong staff is broken, the beautiful rod!’

zhSimplified.text: 凡在她四围的和认识她名的， 你们都要为她悲伤，说： 那结实的杖和那美好的棍， 何竟折断了呢？

zhTraditional.text: 凡在她四圍的和認識她名的， 你們都要為她悲傷，說： 那結實的杖和那美好的棍， 何竟折斷了呢？

en.text: “You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you. He has destroyed your strongholds.

zhSimplified.text: 住在底本的民哪， 要从你荣耀的位上下来， 坐受干渴； 因毁灭摩押的上来攻击你， 毁坏了你的保障。

zhTraditional.text: 住在底本的民哪， 要從你榮耀的位上下來， 坐受乾渴； 因毀滅摩押的上來攻擊你， 毀壞了你的保障。

en.text: Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way and watch. Ask him who flees, and her who escapes; say, ‘What has been done?’

zhSimplified.text: 住亚罗珥的啊， 要站在道旁观望， 问逃避的男人和逃脱的女人说： 是什么事呢？

zhTraditional.text: 住亞羅珥的啊， 要站在道旁觀望， 問逃避的男人和逃脫的女人說： 是甚麼事呢？

en.text: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.

zhSimplified.text: 摩押因毁坏蒙羞； 你们要哀号呼喊， 要在亚嫩旁报告说： 摩押变为荒场！

zhTraditional.text: 摩押因毀壞蒙羞； 你們要哀號呼喊， 要在亞嫩旁報告說： 摩押變為荒場！

en.text: Judgment has come on the plain country— on Holon, on Jahzah, on Mephaath,

zhSimplified.text: 「刑罚临到平原之地的何伦、雅杂、米法押、

zhTraditional.text: 「刑罰臨到平原之地的何倫、雅雜、米法押、

en.text: on Dibon, on Nebo, on Beth Diblathaim,

zhSimplified.text: 底本、尼波、伯·低比拉太音、

zhTraditional.text: 底本、尼波、伯‧低比拉太音、

en.text: on Kiriathaim, on Beth Gamul, on Beth Meon,

zhSimplified.text: 基列亭、伯·迦末、伯·米恩、

zhTraditional.text: 基列亭、伯‧迦末、伯‧米恩、

en.text: on Kerioth, on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

zhSimplified.text: 加略、波斯拉，和摩押地远近所有的城邑。

zhTraditional.text: 加略、波斯拉，和摩押地遠近所有的城邑。

en.text: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken,” says the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 摩押的角砍断了，摩押的膀臂折断了。这是耶和华说的。」

zhTraditional.text: 摩押的角砍斷了，摩押的膀臂折斷了。這是耶和華說的。」

en.text: “Make him drunk, for he magnified himself against the LORD. Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will be in derision.

zhSimplified.text: 「你们要使摩押沉醉，因她向耶和华夸大。她要在自己所吐之中打滚，又要被人嗤笑。

zhTraditional.text: 「你們要使摩押沉醉，因她向耶和華誇大。她要在自己所吐之中打滾，又要被人嗤笑。

en.text: For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? Was he found among thieves? For as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.

zhSimplified.text: 摩押啊，你不曾嗤笑以色列吗？她岂是在贼中查出来的呢？你每逢提到她便摇头。

zhTraditional.text: 摩押啊，你不曾嗤笑以色列嗎？她豈是在賊中查出來的呢？你每逢提到她便搖頭。

en.text: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock. Be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss.

zhSimplified.text: 摩押的居民哪， 要离开城邑，住在山崖里， 像鸽子在深渊口上搭窝。

zhTraditional.text: 摩押的居民哪， 要離開城邑，住在山崖裏， 像鴿子在深淵口上搭窩。

en.text: “We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud in his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the arrogance of his heart.

zhSimplified.text: 我们听说摩押人骄傲， 是极其骄傲； 听说他自高自傲， 并且狂妄，居心自大。

zhTraditional.text: 我們聽說摩押人驕傲， 是極其驕傲； 聽說他自高自傲， 並且狂妄，居心自大。

en.text: I know his wrath,” says the LORD, “that it is nothing; his boastings have done nothing.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华说： 我知道他的忿怒是虚空的； 他夸大的话一无所成。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華說： 我知道他的忿怒是虛空的； 他誇大的話一無所成。

en.text: Therefore I will wail for Moab. Yes, I will cry out for all Moab. They will mourn for the men of Kir Heres.

zhSimplified.text: 因此，我要为摩押哀号， 为摩押全地呼喊； 人必为吉珥·哈列设人叹息。

zhTraditional.text: 因此，我要為摩押哀號， 為摩押全地呼喊； 人必為吉珥‧哈列設人歎息。

en.text: With more than the weeping of Jazer I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah. Your branches passed over the sea. They reached even to the sea of Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your summer fruits and on your vintage.

zhSimplified.text: 西比玛的葡萄树啊，我为你哀哭， 甚于雅谢人哀哭。 你的枝子蔓延过海， 直长到雅谢海。 那行毁灭的已经临到你夏天的果子 和你所摘的葡萄。

zhTraditional.text: 西比瑪的葡萄樹啊，我為你哀哭， 甚於雅謝人哀哭。 你的枝子蔓延過海， 直長到雅謝海。 那行毀滅的已經臨到你夏天的果子 和你所摘的葡萄。

en.text: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab. I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses. No one will tread with shouting. The shouting will be no shouting.

zhSimplified.text: 肥田和摩押地的欢喜快乐都被夺去； 我使酒榨的酒绝流， 无人踹酒欢呼； 那欢呼却变为仇敌的呐喊。

footnotes.text: - 48:33 原文是那欢呼却不是欢呼

zhTraditional.text: 肥田和摩押地的歡喜快樂都被奪去； 我使酒醡的酒絕流， 無人踹酒歡呼； 那歡呼卻變為仇敵的吶喊。

footnotes.text: - 48:33 原文是那歡呼卻不是歡呼

en.text: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz they have uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for the waters of Nimrim will also become desolate.

zhSimplified.text: 「希实本人发的哀声达到以利亚利，直达到雅杂；从琐珥达到何罗念，直到伊基拉·施利施亚，因为宁林的水必然干涸。」

zhTraditional.text: 「希實本人發的哀聲達到以利亞利，直達到雅雜；從瑣珥達到何羅念，直到伊基拉‧施利施亞，因為寧林的水必然乾涸。」

en.text: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab,” says the LORD, “him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华说：「我必在摩押地使那在邱坛献祭的，和那向他的神烧香的都断绝了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華說：「我必在摩押地使那在邱壇獻祭的，和那向他的神燒香的都斷絕了。

en.text: Therefore my heart sounds for Moab like flutes, and my heart sounds like flutes for the men of Kir Heres. Therefore the abundance that he has gotten has perished.

zhSimplified.text: 我心腹为摩押哀鸣如箫，我心肠为吉珥·哈列设人也是如此，因摩押人所得的财物都灭没了。

zhTraditional.text: 我心腹為摩押哀鳴如簫，我心腸為吉珥‧哈列設人也是如此，因摩押人所得的財物都滅沒了。

en.text: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped. There are cuttings on all the hands, and sackcloth on the waist.

zhSimplified.text: 「各人头上光秃，胡须剪短，手有划伤，腰束麻布。

zhTraditional.text: 「各人頭上光禿，鬍鬚剪短，手有劃傷，腰束麻布。

en.text: On all the housetops of Moab, and in its streets, there is lamentation everywhere; for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which no one delights,” says the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 在摩押的各房顶上和街市上处处有人哀哭；因我打碎摩押，好像打碎无人喜悦的器皿。这是耶和华说的。

zhTraditional.text: 在摩押的各房頂上和街市上處處有人哀哭；因我打碎摩押，好像打碎無人喜悅的器皿。這是耶和華說的。

en.text: “How it is broken down! How they wail! How Moab has turned the back with shame! So will Moab become a derision and a terror to all who are around him.”

zhSimplified.text: 摩押何等毁坏！何等哀号！何等羞愧转背！这样，摩押必令四围的人嗤笑惊骇。」

zhTraditional.text: 摩押何等毀壞！何等哀號！何等羞愧轉背！這樣，摩押必令四圍的人嗤笑驚駭。」

en.text: For the LORD says: “Behold, he will fly as an eagle, and will spread out his wings against Moab.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华如此说： 仇敌必如大鹰飞起， 展开翅膀，攻击摩押。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華如此說： 仇敵必如大鷹飛起， 展開翅膀，攻擊摩押。

en.text: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized. The heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

zhSimplified.text: 加略被攻取，保障也被占据。 到那日，摩押的勇士心中疼痛如临产的妇人。

zhTraditional.text: 加略被攻取，保障也被佔據。 到那日，摩押的勇士心中疼痛如臨產的婦人。

en.text: Moab will be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 摩押必被毁灭，不再成国， 因她向耶和华夸大。

zhTraditional.text: 摩押必被毀滅，不再成國， 因她向耶和華誇大。

en.text: Terror, the pit, and the snare are on you, inhabitant of Moab,” says the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华说：摩押的居民哪， 恐惧、陷坑、网罗都临近你。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華說：摩押的居民哪， 恐懼、陷坑、網羅都臨近你。

en.text: “He who flees from the terror will fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit will be taken in the snare, for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation,” says the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 躲避恐惧的必坠入陷坑； 从陷坑上来的必被网罗缠住； 因我必使追讨之年临到摩押。 这是耶和华说的。

zhTraditional.text: 躲避恐懼的必墜入陷坑； 從陷坑上來的必被網羅纏住； 因我必使追討之年臨到摩押。 這是耶和華說的。

en.text: “Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, and a flame from the middle of Sihon, and has devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

zhSimplified.text: 躲避的人无力站在希实本的影下； 因为有火从希实本发出， 有火焰出于西宏的城， 烧尽摩押的角和哄嚷人的头顶。

zhTraditional.text: 躲避的人無力站在希實本的影下； 因為有火從希實本發出， 有火焰出於西宏的城， 燒盡摩押的角和鬨嚷人的頭頂。

en.text: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh are undone; for your sons are taken away captive, and your daughters into captivity.

zhSimplified.text: 摩押啊，你有祸了！ 属基抹的民灭亡了！ 因你的众子都被掳去， 你的众女也被掳去。

zhTraditional.text: 摩押啊，你有禍了！ 屬基抹的民滅亡了！ 因你的眾子都被擄去， 你的眾女也被擄去。

en.text: “Yet I will reverse the captivity of Moab in the latter days,” says the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华说： 到末后，我还要使被掳的摩押人归回。 摩押受审判的话到此为止。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華說： 到末後，我還要使被擄的摩押人歸回。 摩押受審判的話到此為止。
